context: Interactive time series navigator — main chart with minimap overview, LTTB downsampling of 50,000 points, linked brush and scroll-zoom interaction
first_impression: Clean and restrained with a deliberate muted blue palette, the dual-chart layout reads immediately as a focus+context navigator without needing the subtitle.
what_works: Color palette is intentional (Tol palette #4477AA + #EE6677 for LOD dots, not schemeCategory10); the area fill at 0.08 opacity adds depth without competing with the line. Typographic hierarchy is real — monospace stats line, quieter subtitle, muted axis text — and the grid lines (#eee) are nearly invisible, showing restraint.
what_doesnt: The minimap brush selection rectangle (fill-opacity 0.12) is barely distinguishable from the unselected region at a glance — a slightly stronger contrast would make the current viewport position immediately legible. The minimap is also visually underweighted relative to the main chart: its gray-on-gray area fill nearly disappears, leaving it feeling like an afterthought rather than a first-class navigation control.
